title: Smith Micro Announces Expanded Multi-Year Agreement with U.S. Tier 1 Mobile Operator to Advance Family Safety Innovation
summary: Smith Micro expands its long-standing partnership with a major U.S. mobile operator through a new multi-year agreement focused on family safety innovation.
body_markdown:
**PITTSBURGH, PA, September 10, 2026** – Smith Micro Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMSI) today announced a new multi-year, multi-SKU agreement with a major U.S.-based mobile operator that expands the companies’ long-standing partnership and reinforces their shared commitment to delivering innovative family safety solutions. Through Smith Micro’s SafePath® platform, the agreement will support continued investment in new capabilities that help families stay connected, informed, and protected in an increasingly digital world.


The expanded agreement creates a framework for ongoing product innovation, enabling the introduction of new services and experiences designed to enhance value for customers while supporting the company’s family safety strategy.


“We are excited to deepen our relationship with our mobile operator partner through this expanded multi-year agreement,” said Tim Huffmyer, Chief Executive Officer of Smith Micro. “This commitment reflects the strength of our partnership, their confidence in our technology, and our shared vision of delivering industry-leading family safety experiences. Together, we will continue to innovate and bring meaningful solutions that help families stay connected and protected.”


The agreement further strengthens the collaboration between the two companies and establishes a foundation for future growth, product expansion, and broader deployment opportunities across their customer base.


**About Smith Micro Software, Inc.**


Smith Micro develops software to simplify and enhance the mobile experience, providing solutions to some of the leading wireless service providers around the world. From enabling Digital Family Lifestyle™ to providing powerful voice messaging capabilities, Smith Micro’s solutions enrich today’s connected lifestyles while creating new opportunities to engage consumers via smartphones and consumer IoT devices. For more information, visit[smithmicro.com](https://www.smithmicro.com/) .


Smith Micro, the Smith Micro logo and SafePath are registered trademarks of Smith Micro Software, Inc.
